000357: 	{

000306: 	protected Vector3 GetBendDirection(Vector3 IKPosition, Vector3 bendNormal)
000307: 	{
000308: 		Vector3 vector = IKPosition - bone1.transform.position;
000309: 		if (vector == Vector3.zero)
000310: 		{
000311: 			return Vector3.zero;
000312: 		}
000313: 		float sqrMagnitude = vector.sqrMagnitude;
000314: 		float num = (float)Math.Sqrt(sqrMagnitude);
000315: 		float num2 = (sqrMagnitude + bone1.sqrMag - bone2.sqrMag) / 2f / num;
000316: 		float y = (float)Math.Sqrt(Mathf.Clamp(bone1.sqrMag - num2 * num2, 0f, float.PositiveInfinity));
000317: 		Vector3 upwards = Vector3.Cross(vector / num, bendNormal);
000318: 		return Quaternion.LookRotation(vector, upwards) * new Vector3(0f, y, num2);
000319: 	}
000320: }
